privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.description: What information {siteName} collects and how it's used.
privacyPage.intro: {siteName} is a local directory and marketplace for this upazila. This page explains what information we collect when you use the site and how it's used.
privacyPage.collectBody: An account (created via a phone number and one-time code, or email and password) stores your name, phone number, and email if you provide one. If you post a listing or shop, its details and photos are public. Location shared for "near me" search is used only for that search and isn't stored beyond your session. Basic, non-identifying analytics (page views) may be recorded to understand site usage.
privacyPage.useBody: Your account lets you post listings, message sellers, and save favorites. Your phone number is used to verify you're a real person before you can post or contact sellers, and to sign you in. We don't sell your information to third parties.
privacyPage.contactBody: Questions about your data can be sent through the official contact page.

termsPage.title: Terms of Service
termsPage.intro: By using {siteName}, you agree to the following terms.
termsPage.accountBody: You're responsible for what's posted from your account. Provide accurate information and don't impersonate anyone else. Accounts that violate these terms may be suspended.
termsPage.listingsBody: You're responsible for the accuracy of anything you post - listings, shops, reviews, messages. Prohibited, fraudulent, or offensive content will be removed and may be reported to the relevant authority. Moderators may approve, reject, or remove any listing.
termsPage.liabilityBody: {siteName} connects buyers, sellers, and service seekers in this upazila but isn't a party to any transaction between them and isn't responsible for the quality, safety, or legality of items listed, or the accuracy of listings.
termsPage.lawBody: These terms are governed by the laws of Bangladesh.
